You’ll also collaborate closely with colleagues across Trust & Safety, Customer Experience, and Legal, taking ownership of cases and demonstrating our Bumble values of Respect, Curiosity, and Excellence in how you support our community and one another.

This role will be based in the U.S. and will report to the Senior Integrity Operations Manager.

Please note that this position involves exposure to sensitive and graphic content, including but not limited to vulgar, violent, and sexual content.

What you’ll do

  • Investigate and take action on member reports and proactive detections involving safety concerns, including harassment, threats, non-consensual imagery, and other potential violations of Bumble Inc.’s Community Guidelines.

  • Provide thoughtful, high-touch and trauma-informed support to members who have experienced safety incidents, demonstrating Respect and care while following established safety processes.

  • Review accounts and content flagged for potential safety violations, applying policies and operational guidance consistently while using sound judgment to determine appropriate next steps.

  • Manage sensitive and time-critical cases with attention to detail, taking ownership of your work and seeing cases through from initial review to an appropriate outcome.

  • Collaborate purposefully with Trust & Safety, Customer Experience, Legal, and other partners to escalate and help resolve cases that require additional expertise or support.

  • Identify recurring issues, patterns, and opportunities to improve workflows, sharing insights that can strengthen operational consistency and member safety.

  • Use AI-supported tools and internal systems to improve efficiency and support decision-making, reviewing outputs critically for accuracy, bias, privacy, and fairness and applying human judgment before taking action.

  • Participate in on-call rotations, including evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed, adapting with an agile mindset to support our global community.

  • Requires 1+ years of experience, though we welcome candidates with alternative backgrounds that demonstrate equivalent skills.

  • Bring experience in Trust & Safety, customer support, crisis response, content moderation, or another environment where you have handled sensitive or safety-related issues.

  • Apply sound judgment within established policies and processes, balancing efficiency with careful, consistent decision-making and demonstrating Bumble’s values of Respect and Excellence.

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2>An overview of this role</h2> <p>As an AI Transformation Owner at GitLab, you'll shape your function's AI strategy and build the solutions that deliver it. You are the person responsible for identifying where AI can fundamentally change how your org operates, partnering with your Executive Sponsor to align on the biggest challenges, and driving measurable outcomes against them.</p> <p>Think of this as a product management role where the product is your org's way of working. You'll manage the full lifecycle: understanding how work flows today, deciding where AI should reshape it, prioritizing what gets built and in what order, and ensuring what ships actually gets adopted. You'll also prototype solutions, configure agents, and prove what's possible before pulling in engineering support to scale it.</p> <p>You will work closely with an AI Engineer who sits within the Enterprise AI team. Together you form a partnership: you bring the business context, process intelligence, and strategic prioritization. They bring the technical depth, production-grade delivery, and architecture decisions. You'll build working solutions at the no-code and low-code layer, and partner with the AI Engineer on the right approach, tooling, and structure.</p> <h2>What you'll do</h2> <h3>Strategy &amp; Prioritization</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Own your function's AI strategy,</strong> aligned with your Executive Sponsor and business priorities. Understand which metrics matter to the org, identify what will move the needle, define how you'll measure impact, and track progress over time.</li> <li><strong>Map how work flows</strong> across your function end-to-end, including the handoffs upstream and downstream to other orgs. Identify where the real constraints are, not just the ones your team can see. Focus on the 100x problems: where could leveraging AI in a workflow let your org execute it orders of magnitude faster, or at 100x more volume than before?</li> <li><strong>Manage intake</strong> of AI requests, ideas, and pain points from across the function, including via your Champion network. Ensure every team member has a clear route to surface what they need, rather than building independently.</li> <li><strong>Prioritize strategically</strong> against business outcomes and executive guidance. Hold the line on priorities - we cannot change direction every two weeks - and ensure the AI Engineer's time is spent on the highest-impact work.</li> </ul> <h3>Adoption &amp; Change Management</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Reimagine, not just automate.</strong> Challenge your org to think beyond injecting AI into existing workflows. Work with Enterprise AI to spot opportunities to fundamentally rethink how work gets done.</li> <li><strong>Drive adoption and change management</strong> together with the AI Engineer. The best AI solution is worthless if nobody uses it. Create the channels, rituals, and feedback loops that make AI visible in your function: shared spaces for teams to show what they've built, regular office hours, onboarding for new hires, and celebration of wins. Own the rollout and iteration needed to make AI initiatives stick.</li> <li><strong>Coordinate with Enterprise AI</strong> to ensure your function benefits from patterns, tools, and learnings emerging across other parts of the business.</li> <li><strong>Build and bridge the Champion network in your function.</strong> Champions are the peer community that extends your reach beyond what you and the AI Engineer can deliver directly. From early in the role, identify and recruit Champions across sub-teams (5-10% time, formally agreed with their manager), run a regular Champion sync, host demos to the wider function, and act as their bridge to Enterprise AI. Champions are not your reports: you coordinate them, you don't manage them. Without this network, your reach is capped.</li> </ul> <h3>Hands-On Building &amp; Agent Operations</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Build AI agents</strong> using no-code and low-code platforms (e.g. Glean, Workato, similar tools). Go from idea to working prototype without waiting for engineering.</li> <li><strong>Author and iterate on skills files</strong> that define how AI agents behave. Refine instructions based on real usage and share reusable skills across the function.</li> <li><strong>Configure MCP servers and tools,</strong> giving agents access to the business systems they need. Partner with the AI Engineer on what to connect and how to do it securely.</li> <li><strong>Own your function's fleet of agents.</strong> Some agents will be used directly by people in your org. Those that aren't, you own. Either way, you're accountable for their performance: tracking KPIs, running evaluations after model or data changes, and iterating based on what you learn.</li> <li><strong>Expect to rebuild.</strong> AI tools and models evolve fast. The agent you built last month may need to be replaced, not patched. You should be comfortable sunsetting your own work when a better approach emerges, and helping your org stay current rather than attached to what exists today.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring</h2> <h3>Business &amp; Strategic</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Deep knowledge of your function's operations.</strong> You understand how work moves through your org, where it gets stuck, and why. You can trace a process end-to-end and explain how it connects to the teams around it.</li> <li><strong>Strategic prioritization skills.</strong> You've managed competing demands before and can make hard calls about what matters most. You think in terms of business outcomes, not activity.</li> <li><strong>A product management mindset.</strong> You naturally think about intake, backlog, iteration, and adoption. You're comfortable defining success metrics and holding yourself accountable to them.</li> <li><strong>Strong communication and influence.</strong> You'll be the person saying "not yet" to some teams and "think bigger" to others. You need the credibility and interpersonal skills to make both of those conversations land.</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional instincts.</strong> You default to understanding how your org's processes affect and are affected by the teams around you - not just optimising in isolation.</li> <li><strong>Experience building peer networks or communities of practice.</strong> You've recruited and sustained volunteer contributors before, whether as a guild lead, champion program owner, or community organizer. You know how to motivate people whose time you don't directly own.</li> </ul> <h3>Hands-On &amp; Technical</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Comfortable building with AI tools.</strong> You don't need to write production code, but you should be able to build a working agent, configure a skill, connect an MCP server, and troubleshoot when something isn't working. Think: power user, not software engineer.</li> <li><strong>Ready to learn fast.</strong> Experience with or willingness to quickly pick up no-code/low-code AI platforms, prompt engineering, and agent configuration. You'll be trained on GitLab's specific tooling, but you should arrive ready to get your hands dirty.</li> <li><strong>Strong conceptual understanding of AI capabilities</strong> - summarization, classification, generation, automation, agentic workflows - and a commitment to staying current. The landscape shifts constantly. The tools you use today may be obsolete in weeks. You stay on top of new developments so that your org's AI strategy reflects what's actually possible, not what was possible six months ago.</li> <li><strong>Ability to map data flows</strong> - structured and unstructured. Understand where agents need context, and figure out where humans should interface with automated workflows and at what steps.</li> </ul> <h2>About the team</h2> <p>You will partner closely with Enterprise AI within the Enterprise Technology &amp; AI organization, while remaining embedded in your own function. Enterprise AI provides the technical delivery capability, platforms, and patterns. You provide the business context, prioritization, building at the no-code layer, and adoption muscle. Together, you form the core of your function's AI transformation.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><em>The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the&nbsp;United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US.&nbsp;Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data,&nbsp;and geographic location.&nbsp;The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary.</em></p></div><div class="title">United States Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$203,200</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$345,600 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off&nbsp;</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation &amp; Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a>&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices and 68% (and growing!) of NHS Trusts. raw.description:
About SugarAI UK Limited

SugarAI is redefining CRM for the age of AI.

We’re delivering on the original promise of CRM—turning fragmented customer and revenue signals into clear, prioritized action. Instead of more dashboards or surface-level insights, we help teams focus on what matters most and know exactly what to do next.

More than two decades after our founding, we’re entering a new chapter with clarity and momentum—building intelligent, intuitive solutions that work within the flow of how teams actually sell and serve. We’re focused on solving complex, real-world challenges where relationships, context, and precision make all the difference.

Our global team is united by a shared commitment to impact, ownership, and continuous growth. We create an environment where thoughtful ideas move quickly, where people are trusted to lead, and where flexibility supports how great work gets done.

If you’re excited to help shape what’s next in AI-driven CRM—and build technology that drives real outcomes—we’d love to meet you.

Where You Fit In: 
SugarAI ships AI-powered selling and sales intelligence products in a market that moves faster every day. We are focused on quality, functionality, and speed to delivery, and the engineers who thrive here don't treat AI tools as a productivity add-on they've fundamentally changed how they work, using agentic development workflows to go from specification to production-ready code faster than they could before, without sacrificing correctness or quality. 

This is not a role for someone who favors traditional software development, or is curious about AI-assisted development and plans to explore it. It's a role for someone who already works this way who writes clear, machine-readable specifications that feed the agentic development system, uses agentic development tools as standard equipment, and applies genuine critical judgment to what these tools produce before it ships. You'll build systems and features that power real customer outcomes in a B2B SaaS platform at scale, and you'll do it inside a delivery model where human judgment is the differentiating input, not the bottleneck. 

If you want to work on meaningful software with teammates who hold the bar high on both speed and craft, this role is for you.

This role operates on a hybrid model, with a mix of remote work and in-office collaboration at our Solihull location, specifically, working in-office a minimum of 2 days per week.

 

Disclaimer: When applying to this job posting, you are submitting your application for consideration of a role which may or may not actually exist, or be available now or in the future. Application submission is agreeing to be added to our Applicant Tracking System database, so we have the potential to surface your profile and reach out to you in the future, for opportunities which appear to be aligned to your background, experience or network.
 
To be considered for a specific job opening, please check out our Careers Page and apply to an active job posting. 

Impact You Will Make in the Role (Key Responsibilities): 

Agentic Development Systems 

  • Work from executable specifications — write clear SDD/BDD specs and acceptance criteria as the primary input for AI-assisted code generation, and keep them current as implementation evolves 

  • Use agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) as standard equipment across the full SDLC, from spec to implementation to test generation to code review 

  • Apply critical judgment to AI-generated code and agentic attestations before merge — assess correctness, edge cases, security implications, and alignment with the spec; your review is a real gate, not a formality 

  • Contribute to the team's agentic development practices: spec standards, attestation norms, and how the team uses AI tools responsibly 

Feature Delivery 

  • Design, implement, and ship features and components that are reliable, maintainable, and built to perform in high volume, high-availability SaaS environments 

  • Ensure agentic code is clean, well tested, and follows the standards that make it easy to understand and extend by both agentic systems and your teammates 

  • Own your feature areas end-to-end, from understanding the requirement to production delivery, including identifying and resolving defects before they reach customers 

Code Quality & Review 

  • Review outputs, including AI-generated code and agentic attestations, with the care and rigor the team depends on; catch what automation misses 

  • Orchestrate unit and integration test development that verifies real behaviour, not just execution paths; apply the same critical eye to test quality as to production code 

  • Contribute to the team's technical standards and raise the bar on engineering operations excellence across all facets of our AI SDLC 

Collaboration & Systems Thinking 

  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and QA engineers to understand requirements and build the right thing, not just the specified thing 

  • Think beyond your immediate feature: understand the systems your code interacts with, the data it produces, and the downstream effects of your design decisions 

  • Communicate clearly in writing in specs, in code reviews, in async updatesto keep cross-functional and globally distributed teams aligned 

  • Participate in agile and team ceremonies, including Sprint Review, Program Reviews, and other technical presentations 


What You Will Bring (Qualifications/Experience): 

  • 2–5 years of experience developing enterprise or SaaS software in production environments 

  • Personal fluency with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalents) you use these in your daily work and real delivery scenarios, not as an experiment 

  • Hands-on experience with BDD/SDD frameworks and working from executable specifications as the primary input to development, this is how we work, not a practice you're learning on the job 

  • Proficiency in at least one object-oriented or modern SaaS language; comfort picking up new languages and frameworks as the work demands 

  • Experience with RESTful API design and consumption 

  • Working knowledge of SQL and NoSQL data stores 

  • Experience producing and maintaining automated test suites (unit, integration, or end-to-end) 

  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments with CI/CD pipelines 

  • Strong written communication skills; able to write clear specs, meaningful code review feedback, and async updates for a global team 


Preferred Qualifications/Experience: 

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS or equivalent) and microservices architectures 

  • Familiarity with containerization, infrastructure-as-code, or observability tooling 

  • Experience developing or integrating with AI/ML features in a production SaaS product 

  • Background in B2B SaaS, CRM, or revenue technology 

We understand that no candidate is perfectly qualified for any job. Experience comes in different forms; many skills are transferable; and passion goes a long way. Even more important than your resume is a clear demonstration of dedication, impact, and the ability to thrive in a fluid and collaborative environment. We want you to learn new things in this role, and we encourage you to apply if your experience is close to what we’re looking for. We also know that diversity of background and thought makes for better problem solving and more creative thinking, which is why we're dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team.
 
Benefits and Perks:
Beyond a stellar work environment, friendly people, and inspiring work, we have some sweet benefits and perks:
 
·       UK Pension Scheme
·       Private medical and dental insurance
·       Health &Wellness Reimbursement Program
·       Unpaid sabbatical leave
·       Educational Resources - Career & Personal Development Program
·       Various discount programs (i.e. travel, virtual exercises classes, etc.)
·       We are a merit-based company with many opportunities to learn, excel and grow your career!

Provide coaching and support, ensuring workloads are effectively managed.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Campaign Management:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own the day-to-day execution and effective management of designated paid search and paid social accounts, ensuring ongoing and timely optimization and proactively identifying tactical and strategic opportunities and forecasting.</li> <li>Develop comprehensive biddable media plans (+ supporting material) aligned with client objectives and KPIs, clearly articulating the rationale for proposed tactics.</li> <li>Responsible for end-to-end setup of biddable campaigns across relevant platforms, utilizing advanced features (e.g., bid rules, 3rd party tools).</li> <li>Oversee and ensure regular Quality Assurance (QA) checks, monitoring campaign performance, pacing, troubleshooting, and optimizing to improve performance.</li> <li>Produce detailed and accurate weekly/monthly campaign performance reports and insightful commentary, including end-of-campaign reporting and quarterly/annual reviews.</li> <li>Identify trends and recommend on-platform actions to capitalize/mitigate these trends.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Client &amp; Partner Management:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop strong relationships with colleagues supporting campaign delivery, your client, and key suppliers, leading team communications and building rapport to become knowledge of the client sector/industry and media/technology developments, identifying strategic issues and opportunities to test and innovate in the biddable space.</li> </ul> <p><strong>People the immediate and wider team when required, attending interviews and acting as an ambassador.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Operational Excellence:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Make full use of technology, implementing processes that maximize operational efficiencies and identify opportunities for improvement.</li> <li>Take ownership of issues when they arise, proactively suggesting resolutions and preventative measures.</li> <li>Contribute to the development of strategic revenue and services opportunities.</li> <li>Ensure financial accuracy, integrating the planning and buying process, and reconciliation of spends, including client terms and fees.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with planning teams and other channel specialists to ensure biddable activity complements and enhances the wider marketing mix.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Biddable Expertise:</strong>&nbsp;Proven experience in both Paid Search (Google Ads, Bing Ads) and Paid Social (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest etc.), with current certifications (Google and Microsoft Ads, Meta Blueprint desirable).</li> <li><strong>Leadership &amp; Innovation:</strong>&nbsp;Leads and promotes continuous innovation, and test &amp; learn opportunities for the team and clients. Creates a positive climate to drive team performance whilst motivating others.</li> <li><strong>Analytical &amp; Strategic:</strong>&nbsp;Excellent knowledge of bid management, core PPC/social technology platforms, and data analysis. Strong analytical skills with an aptitude for handling data to identify trends and actionable insights. Ability to devise campaign strategy and translate it into effective delivery.</li> <li><strong>People Management:</strong>&nbsp;Proven experience managing individuals, overseeing their work and development, and motivating team members.</li> <li><strong>Client &amp; Partner Management:</strong>&nbsp;Strong relationship-building skills with clients, colleagues supporting campaign delivery, and key suppliers; ability to foster good working relationships across client teams.</li> <li><strong>Communication:</strong>&nbsp;Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with people from diverse backgrounds, cultures, and countries, including translating technical points to non-technical audiences.</li> <li><strong>Mindset:</strong>&nbsp;Passionate about Biddable media, leading by example, and driving continuous improvement.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Who we are</h3> <p>Typeform is a refreshingly different form builder. Designed to look striking and feel effortless to fill out, Typeform drives 500 million responses every year—and integrates with essential tools like Slack, Zapier, and Hubspot.</p></div><p data-section-id="1wdkf9o" data-start="1250" data-end="1267">Typeform is fully remote by design. For this role, we can hire candidates based in the UK, Ireland, Germany, Portugal or The Netherlands</p> <h2 data-section-id="1wdkf9o" data-start="1250" data-end="1267">About the team</h2> <p data-start="1269" data-end="1487">Product Operations sits at the center of how our Product and wider R&amp;D teams work. We help create the systems, practices, and connections that allow teams to focus on solving the right problems and delivering great products.</p> <p data-start="1489" data-end="1741">AI is becoming an increasingly important part of that work. Across R&amp;D, teams are already experimenting with tools like Glean and Claude, building automations, testing agents, and finding new ways to use AI throughout the product development lifecycle.</p> <p data-start="1743" data-end="1817">The opportunity now is to turn that energy into something more systematic.That's where you come in.</p> <h2 data-section-id="1wdgaw5" data-start="1846" data-end="1863">About the role</h2> <p data-start="1865" data-end="1976">We're looking for an <strong data-start="1886" data-end="1908">AI Product Operations Lead</strong> to build and operate the internal AI Operations capability for R&amp;D.</p> <p data-start="1978" data-end="2318">This is a hands-on role for someone who can take an ambiguous opportunity and turn it into a reliable, adopted solution. title: Senior AI Product Engineer
description: Do you want to build the AI systems that compliance teams rely on to investigate real financial crime? Are you excited about taking agentic workflows from prototype to production at scale? Do you want your work to directly help catch bad actors moving money across blockchains? Elliptic is hiring a Senior AI Engineer to join our AI team. It is the team behind Elliptic's copilot, the AI product that helps compliance investigators trace fund flows, surface patterns, and respond to risk in real time. This role sits at the centre of that work, designing the agentic systems, LLM integrations, and backend services that turn complex blockchain data into useful answers. You'll join a focused team that cares about the quality of what it builds and gives you the space to do your best work. There's real ownership here, breadth across AI and backend systems, and the freedom to turn good ideas into shipped products. The problems are technically challenging, and the work is visible. The impact you will have: As a Senior AI Engineer on the AI team, you'll own significant parts of the Agentic stack that power Elliptic's copilot. You'll lead the design of agentic workflows, drive technical decisions on how we build and operate LLM-based features, and help raise the engineering standard across the team. You'll partner with product, web engineers, and your engineering lead to take complex problems from ambiguity to shipped product, and you'll mentor more junior engineers as the team grows. What you will do: Design and build agentic workflows and AI-powered features that power Elliptic's copilot, using LLM frameworks such as LangChain or LangGraph. Lead the design of agents, tool integrations, and retrieval pipelines that turn complex blockchain data into useful answers for investigators. Build and own evaluation frameworks that measure and improve the quality, reliability, and latency of LLM outputs. Design and build the backend services, APIs, and event-driven systems that support these features, using TypeScript and Node.js. Drive technical design reviews and architecture decisions for AI workstreams. Mentor and coach more junior engineers through pair programming, code review, and design feedback. Raise the engineering bar across the team by promoting good practices in testing, observability, and AI system reliability. Influence cross-team decisions on how AI capabilities integrate with the rest of the Elliptic platform. What you will achieve in the first 6 months: Owned and shipped at least one significant AI capability end-to-end, from ambiguous problem statement through to production. Driven the technical direction of an AI workstream, including architecture, evaluation, and rollout. Established or improved at least one team practice for building AI systems (evals, observability patterns, prompt management, rollout safety). Mentored junior engineers on AI engineering practices and contributed to their growth. Built strong working relationships across product, web engineering, data engineering, and DevOps. Started to influence adjacent teams on how Elliptic builds with AI. You will be a great fit here if you: Care about building AI systems that work reliably in production, not just demos. Have strong instincts for trade-offs specific to LLM systems: cost vs latency vs quality, deterministic vs probabilistic behaviour, when to use an agent vs a workflow. Can take ambiguous AI problems and break them into shippable pieces with clear evaluation criteria. Communicate clearly with non-engineers (product, stakeholders, leadership) about AI capabilities and limitations. Have coached or mentored other engineers and enjoy raising the bar through reviews, pairing, and feedback. Are genuinely curious about the domain and find blockchain investigations and financial crime prevention interesting. Our ideal candidate has: 5-8+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 1-2 years of meaningful production work building LLM-powered features. Direct experience with LLM frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or similar. Hands-on experience building agentic systems: tool use, multi-step reasoning, planning, memory, and human-in-the-loop patterns. Practical understanding of prompt engineering, structured outputs, context management, and managing the trade-offs of working with LLMs. Experience building and running evaluations for LLM outputs (eval sets, LLM-as-judge, regression testing). Strong backend skills in TypeScript / Node.js, with solid API design. Cloud experience (AWS: Lambda, ECS, S3, or similar). Database proficiency across SQL (Postgres) and some NoSQL exposure. Demonstrated ability to mentor and coach other engineers. Uses AI coding assistants (Copilot, Cursor, Claude, etc.) critically and effectively as part of their day-to-day workflow. Bonus points for: Experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, or similar). Experience designing multi-agent systems and agent orchestration patterns. Familiarity with LLM observability tools (LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize, or similar). Experience working with multiple model providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, open-weight models) or with fine-tuning. Hands-on experience with Terraform, Kubernetes, or infrastructure-as-code tooling. Experience with observability platforms like Datadog. Distributed or event-driven architectures (SNS, SQS). Interest in cryptocurrency, blockchain, or compliance. title: Principal Infrastructure Engineer
description: <p><strong>About Sezzle:</strong></p> <p>With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong>:</p> <p>For this principal development role, with 12+ years of experience, the compensation range is <strong>&nbsp;$12,500 - $20,800 USD based on location and experience level </strong>per month and in gross amount. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience</p> <p><strong>About the Role:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p class="p1">We are seeking an exceptional <strong>Principal Infrastructure Engineer</strong> to design, build, operate, and scale the platform that powers Sezzle. Your focus will be the hardest infrastructure problems: increasing throughput, reducing latency, removing capacity bottlenecks, strengthening resilience, and making production operations more automated and predictable as the business grows.</p> <p class="p1">You will own complex technical initiatives from architecture and prototyping through implementation, production rollout, and ongoing operation. Your impact will come from the systems you build, the problems you solve, and measurable improvements in reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.</p> <p class="p1">Our stack runs on <strong>AWS</strong>, with workloads orchestrated on <strong>Kubernetes</strong> and data anchored in <strong>Aurora RDS (MySQL and Postgres)</strong>. You should know these technologies deeply and be comfortable moving between cloud architecture, networking, cluster internals, database performance, and application behavior to understand how the entire system scales. You will write code and infrastructure-as-code, debug production systems, and deliver changes that hold up under real traffic and failure conditions.</p> <p class="p1">Operational ownership is part of the job. You will <strong>participate in the on-call rotation</strong> and take a hands-on role in recovering from major incidents, including full outages. We need someone who can form and test hypotheses using logs, metrics, and traces, make sound mitigation decisions with incomplete information, and turn incident findings into lasting engineering fixes.</p> <p class="p1">You will also build and apply <strong>AI-assisted infrastructure and SRE tooling</strong> for incident investigation, capacity analysis, runbook automation, and toil reduction. You will evaluate these tools through practical results and apply appropriate access controls, validation, and auditability to their use in production.</p> <p class="p1">This role reports to engineering leadership and works closely with application engineers, Security, and Compliance. You will develop a deep understanding of how Sezzle's business operates and how customer journeys, transaction patterns, and product decisions shape infrastructure demand and behavior. You will use that understanding to identify and deliver improvements across teams and technical domains, connecting infrastructure decisions to better customer outcomes and business performance.</p> <p class="p1"><strong>What you’ll do:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li class="li1"><strong>Own the technical architecture and evolution of core infrastructure</strong>: identify system limits, prioritize technical improvements, and implement changes that support increasing traffic, data volume, and workload complexity.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Connect business understanding to improvements across the system</strong>: learn how key business workflows behave in production, trace their impact across applications, data, and infrastructure, and partner across teams to improve performance, reliability, and cost efficiency beyond any single service or team's scope.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Engineer for scale and performance</strong>: build capacity models, run load and stress tests, diagnose bottlenecks across compute, networking, Kubernetes, and databases, and validate improvements against throughput, latency, saturation, and cost per workload.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Design and build AWS infrastructure</strong>: implement resilient account, IAM, network, and service architectures; address service quotas, fault isolation, and multi-AZ or multi-region requirements as workloads grow.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Build and operate the Kubernetes platform</strong>: improve cluster architecture, lifecycle automation, workload isolation, resource allocation, autoscaling, safe upgrades, and deployment reliability.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Scale and optimize Aurora RDS for MySQL and Postgres</strong>: tune queries and indexes, address connection and replication bottlenecks, plan capacity, improve failover behavior, and implement safe schema changes and database migrations with application engineers.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Improve reliability through engineering</strong>: define and instrument service-level objectives and error budgets with service owners; implement failure isolation, backpressure, load shedding, and safe retry behavior where needed to prevent cascading failures.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Participate in on-call and drive technical recovery during serious incidents</strong>: use evidence-based triage, execute mitigations, communicate findings, and implement corrective actions from postmortems.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Implement and test disaster recovery</strong>: design backup, restore, and failover mechanisms against agreed recovery time and recovery point objectives; run recovery exercises and document measured results.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Build infrastructure-as-code and operational automation</strong>: make provisioning, configuration, deployments, upgrades, and recovery reproducible, reviewed, testable, and recoverable. Eliminate recurring manual work through code.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Build observability that makes production diagnosable</strong>: improve metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and actionable alerts, with visibility into service health, scaling limits, and customer impact.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Deliver safe infrastructure migrations</strong>: design phased rollouts, compatibility checks, validation, and rollback paths for changes to shared production systems.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Improve cloud cost efficiency through technical changes</strong>: right-size resources, improve utilization, tune autoscaling and storage, and quantify savings while maintaining reliability and performance targets.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Build and evaluate AI-assisted operational tooling</strong>: apply AI to investigation, runbooks, anomaly analysis, and repetitive operations, with bounded permissions, reviewable actions, and measurable improvements in accuracy or toil.</li> <li class="li2"><strong>Make technical decisions clear and executable</strong>: write architecture proposals, evaluate technology tradeoffs through prototypes and benchmarks, review changes affecting shared infrastructure, and document how systems operate and fail.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We look for:</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li class="li1">Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a similar technical field (required)</li> <li class="li1"><strong>12+ years</strong> of experience across infrastructure, platform, site reliability, software development, or related engineering disciplines, with substantial hands-on depth designing and operating production infrastructure at scale.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Deep expertise with AWS</strong>: production experience across compute, IAM, multi-account architectures, and networking, including VPC design and private connectivity.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Deep expertise with Kubernetes in production</strong>: cluster lifecycle, scheduling, resource management, autoscaling, networking, and troubleshooting business-critical workloads. EKS experience is strongly preferred.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Deep expertise with relational databases at scale</strong>, specifically <strong>RDS/Aurora (MySQL and/or Postgres)</strong>: query performance, indexing, connection management, replication, high availability, failover, and verified backup and recovery.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>A track record of personally delivering infrastructure scaling improvements</strong>: identifying constraints, measuring baseline behavior, implementing changes, and demonstrating gains in capacity, latency, reliability, or cost efficiency.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Strong coding and automation skills</strong>, using Golang, Python, or similar languages to build production tooling and eliminate operational toil, alongside infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform or equivalent.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Strong systems fundamentals</strong>: Linux, networking, DNS, TLS, storage, concurrency, and distributed system failure modes, with the ability to debug problems across infrastructure and application boundaries.</li> <li class="li1">Experience operating a <strong>24/7, high-availability platform</strong> where downtime has direct customer or revenue impact, including hands-on incident response and postmortem remediation.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation</strong> and demonstrated ability to recover production systems under pressure using evidence-based triage, safe mitigation, and clear technical communication.</li> <li class="li1">Experience implementing and testing <strong>disaster recovery</strong> against defined recovery objectives, including restoring data and validating service recovery.</li> <li class="li1">Practical experience with <strong>observability, load testing, capacity planning, and safe CI/CD practices</strong> for shared production infrastructure.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Active use of AI tooling in engineering or operations</strong>, with practical judgment about its limitations and how to verify generated code, recommendations, and operational actions.</li> <li class="li1">Ability to carry ambiguous technical problems from investigation through production delivery and collaborate across engineering disciplines to resolve system-wide constraints.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred Knowledge and Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li class="li1">Experience in <strong>fintech, payments, or banking</strong>, operating infrastructure with demanding reliability, security, and audit requirements.</li> <li class="li1">Experience with <strong>multi-region architectures, chaos engineering, and failure testing</strong>, including the consistency and recovery tradeoffs of distributed data systems.</li> <li class="li1">Proficiency with <strong>Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo</strong>, or comparable observability systems.</li> <li class="li1">Experience building <strong>internal platform capabilities and self-service tooling</strong>, including deployment automation, progressive delivery, and reusable infrastructure components.</li> <li class="li1">Experience building <strong>AI-assisted incident investigation or operational automation</strong> with restricted access, auditable execution, and clear human review points</li> <li>&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>About You:&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>You have relentlessly high standards</strong> - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.</li> <li><strong>You’re not bound by convention</strong> - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things</li> <li><strong>You need action</strong> - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.</li> <li><strong>You earn trust</strong> - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.</li> <li><strong>You have backbone; disagree, then commit </strong>- you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.</li> <li><strong>You deliver results </strong>- you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>You go deep</strong>: you investigate how systems behave under load and failure, follow the evidence, and fix underlying causes.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>You build and ship</strong>: you turn architecture into working code, tested infrastructure, and safe production changes.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>You measure results</strong>: you can explain the impact of your work in availability, latency, capacity, recovery time, cost, or hours of toil removed.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>You value simplicity</strong>: you choose systems that are understandable, operable, and appropriate to the problem, and reduce unnecessary complexity.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>You earn trust</strong>: you listen carefully, communicate clearly, challenge technical decisions respectfully, and follow through on commitments.</li> <li class="li1"><strong>You stay accountable for the outcome</strong>: you verify that changes work in production and that fixes remain effective as the platform scales.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Sezzle’s Technology Stack:</strong></p> <ul> <li class="li1"><strong>Languages:</strong> Golang, Python</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Database:</strong> MySQL, Postgres</li> <li class="li1"><strong>DevOps and Cloud:</strong> AWS, Kubernetes</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Version Control:</strong> Git</li> <li class="li1"><strong>CI/CD:</strong> Gitlab</li> <li class="li1"><strong>Open Source:</strong> Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. title: Staff Product Manager, Machine Learning
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>The climate crisis is the defining challenge of our time—but it’s also the greatest opportunity for innovation, and a challenge we’re proud to take on. At Overstory, we’re harnessing cutting-edge technology to enable a resilient electrical grid that keeps communities thriving as our world changes.</p> <p>The grid is the backbone of life as we know it. It powers hospitals, keeps food fresh, and ensures communities stay connected. But extreme weather, aging infrastructure, and growing wildfire risks are putting this critical system under pressure. All of this combined makes the electric utility industry the greatest opportunity for tackling climate change.&nbsp;</p> <p>One of the leading causes of catastrophic wildfires and power outages? Trees and brush coming into contact with power lines.&nbsp;</p> <p>That’s where we help. At Overstory, we use AI and advanced satellite imagery to pinpoint and prioritize vegetation risks before they materialize. By giving utilities critical analysis on those risks, we’re helping prevent outages, reduce wildfire risks, and accelerate the transition to a safer, more resilient grid.</p> <p>Our team spans the Americas and Europe, and we work with utility partners across the Americas and beyond. We’re outdoor enthusiasts, musicians, artists, athletes, parents, and adventurers. What unites us is a passion for solving complex problems, a commitment to climate action, and the belief that technology should be a force for good.</p> <p>Join us to help us build a more resilient world together.&nbsp;</p></div><h2><strong>Role &amp; Team</strong></h2> <p>You’ll lead a core part of our Vegetation Intelligence, the product area that turns remote sensing imagery and data into the vegetation insights that utilities act on every day, through world-class machine learning models. It’s one of Overstory’s most foundational products, live with customers now, and it sits at the center of how we prevent outages and stop wildfires. Every missed tree is an outage or a fire that could have been prevented.</p> <p>The job is twofold. One is real ML-adjacent work: pushing our detection models further and turning their raw outputs into risk data precise enough for customers to trust and act on. You’ll need to be comfortable with complex machine learning models and geospatial data, close to the data science and engineering teams, and fluent enough in model trade-offs to make good calls with data scientists and ML engineers.</p> <p>The other side is where you get to build new capabilities: taking that same data and pushing it into new products and capabilities customers don't have yet. You'll run user research, ground new product bets in the decisions customers make in the field, and turn a strong model into products that prevent real fires and real outages.</p> <p>You’ll report to the Director of Product and own the strategy and roadmap for this product area end to end.</p> <p><strong>Time Zone Requirement:</strong> Europe (GMT/WET, CET, EET) and Eastern North America (NST, AST, EST, CST) Comfortable maintaining 3-4 hours of overlap European working hours for collaboration with the broader Overstory team.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own the roadmap for Vegetation Intelligence, spanning from the ML models that produce our risk data to the products that turn it into customer action.</li> <li>Push our detection models further, and help fold their outputs into Overstory’s broader outage and ignition risk models.</li> <li>Contribute towards increasing the number of actionable insights: run user research, ground priorities in the operational decisions customers actually make, and make sure what we ship drives real action in the field.</li> <li>Shift the roadmap from scaling- and technical-led to customer-driven, without losing the technical rigor that got us here.</li> <li>Work closely with data scientists and ML engineers to turn model capability into shipped product value, and define what “good” looks like for a model in production.</li> <li>Explore how feedback from customers and end users, like arborists, can improve model performance over time.</li> <li>Communicate clearly and often with the broader product and engineering team, so trade-offs, model limits, and priorities stay visible.</li> <li>Contribute to Overstory’s broader product strategy so Vegetation Insights supports where the rest of the product is headed</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Skills &amp; Experience</strong></h2> <ul> <li>8+ years of product management experience, with a track record that proves both craft and shipping speed.</li> <li>Hands-on experience building and shipping products powered by machine learning models. You understand how models get built, trained, evaluated, and improved, and you can talk model performance and trade-offs directly with data scientists and ML engineers.</li> <li>Experience turning a scaling- or technical-led roadmap into a customer-driven one, including running user research and translating it into product priorities.</li> <li>Experience working in a fast-paced startup, comfortable with ambiguity and making calls before everything’s fully defined.</li> <li>A track record building B2B products that customers rely on daily, including products where the value comes from turning data or model outputs into decisions customers can act on.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication. You bring clarity to technical trade-offs and bring teams along as priorities shift.</li> <li>Experience leading product strategy and roadmapping, and building consensus across product, engineering, and data science</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Nice-to-haves</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Experience building geospatial products or working with GIS technologies.</li> <li>Experience with complex data products, especially data pipelines and platforms, including ingesting and processing large, diverse datasets from multiple sources.</li> <li>Experience building machine learning products for image-based applications, like computer vision or image recognition.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>Note:</strong> We believe that all people are capable of great things. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all of the requirements that are listed within this job description.</em></p> <h2><strong>What we offer&nbsp;</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Competitive, location-specific compensation and benefits&nbsp;</li> <li>Flexible, autonomous and collaborative working environment rooted in trust - we build our work days around our lives, not the other way around</li> <li>Home office stipend, coworking and ongoing education budgets&nbsp;</li> <li>A company culture that genuinely embodies each of our core values</li> <li>To be part of truly mission-driven work that reduces wildfires, protects earth’s natural resources and helps solve our climate crisis</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>About Our Team</strong></h2> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">We are a fast-growing team of about 100 people from all over the world. Fifteen nationalities are represented and at last count we speak fourteen languages: English, Dutch, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Luxembourgish, Lithuanian, Bulgarian, Finnish, Estonian, and Afrikaans.</p> <p>We work remotely from eleven countries and are looking for candidates that are living and working in one of them: United States, the Netherlands, United Kingdom, Ireland, Estonia, Portugal, France, Sweden, Switzerland, Denmark and Canada. We gather once a year in-person for our unforgettable team gathering event. We also offer the option to occasionally meet up for in-person collaboration.&nbsp;</p> <h2><strong>Diversity &amp; Inclusion</strong></h2> <p>The climate crisis is a human crisis that requires diverse perspectives to solve.&nbsp;</p> <p>We place enormous value on diversity and believe that the best ideas emerge when people with different backgrounds and experience work together. We remain committed to scaling a team that reflects the communities we serve, and strive to uphold equitable and inclusive practices across every aspect of our business. We are responsible for creating and maintaining a culture where everyone - regardless of background - has a voice in building a sustainable future.</p> <h2><strong>Our Values</strong></h2> <h4><strong>Tackling the climate crisis is our greatest mission.</strong></h4> <p>We act with urgency.</p> <h4><strong>Our curiosity fuels our growth.</strong></h4> <p>We recognize that change is constant, and we find joy and power in exploration.</p> <h4><strong>We’re rooted in diversity.</strong></h4> <p>Just as ecosystems need biodiversity to thrive, our resiliency comes from our differences.</p> <h4><strong>We care for each other.</strong></h4> <p>We love the power of machines but we nurture each other as humans.</p> <h4><strong>Trust is fundamental.</strong></h4> <p>We assume the best in everyone, and we share ideas openly so that we have a positive impact.</p> <p>_________________________________</p> <p data-start="90" data-end="127"><strong data-start="90" data-end="125">Use of AI in Our Hiring Process</strong></p> <p><em>We sometimes use AI tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as helping us manage applications more efficiently or ensuring job descriptions are clear and inclusive. All hiring decisions are always made by people, not machines. Any data processed by AI is handled securely in line with GDPR and our <a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="https://www.overstory.com/privacy-policy" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.overstory.com/privacy-policy" data-sk="tooltip_parent">Privacy Notice</a>.</em></p></div> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

À propos de nAIxt Consulting / ILLUIN Technology

nAIxt Consulting est la practice conseil d'ILLUIN Technology, société née en 2017 au cœur de CentraleSupélec, l'un des clusters IA de référence en Europe. Spécialisée dans l'IA appliquée dans les entreprises (grands groupes, comptes publics, ETI, PME), ILLUIN est pionnière du NLP francophone et mène ses propres recherches en IA générative. Nos consultants interviennent en immersion chez le client pour déployer des solutions IA à fort impact (assistants conversationnels, automatisation documentaire, analyse de données), avec la vision agnostique des technologies IA (solutions du marché, produits Illuin, des approches sur mesure).

Le rôle

Nous recherchons plusieurs Forward Deployed Strategist (FDS) pour rejoindre nôtre équipe. Dans ce rôle, vous portez la stratégie d'intégration des solutions IA (de l’automatisation des tâches ponctuelles à la vision Agentic), l'adoption et l'orchestration des transformations IA, en collaboration avec les Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE). Immergé chez le client, vous faites le lien entre les décideurs, les métiers et les équipes de delivery pour transformer le potentiel de l'IA en usages réels et mesurables.

Vous pilotez la transformation IA d'un périmètre métier. Vous construisez la stratégie d'adoption, orchestrez les acteurs (direction, métiers, IT, Data) et garantissez un impact mesurable, du cadrage des cas d'usage jusqu'à l'ancrage des nouveaux usages.

Vos missions

Stratégie & cadrage

  • Construire la feuille de route IA d'un périmètre métier et la faire vivre

  • Qualifier et prioriser le portefeuille de cas d'usage selon la valeur, la faisabilité et les risques

  • Concevoir les processus cibles intégrant l'IA et les agents, et définir les interactions entre l'humain et l'IA

  • Construire les business cases et les critères Go / No Go avec les décideurs

  • Identifier dès le cadrage les prérequis de sécurité, de gouvernance et de qualité des données

  • Éclairer les arbitrages entre produits existants et développements sur mesure (Make vs Buy)

Orchestration de la transformation

  • Dialoguer d'égal à égal avec le Delivery Manager sur l'avancement, les risques et les arbitrages priorité/délai/périmètre

  • Être en mesure d'assurer un pilotage projet de bout en bout sur des missions à faible volumétrie ne justifiant pas un Delivery Manager dédié

  • Aligner direction, métiers, IT et Data autour d'objectifs et d'un plan partagés

  • Séquencer les déploiements pour que chaque cas d'usage renforce le suivant

  • Planifier les déploiements, anticiper les dépendances et lever les blocages

  • Piloter le passage des pilotes à l'échelle avec les équipes de delivery ILLUIN

  • Préparer et animer les instances de pilotage (Coproj, Copil)

Adoption & conduite du changement

  • Concevoir la stratégie d'adoption (formation, communication, relais métiers, rituels)

  • Construire les plans de montée en compétences

  • Installer et animer des réseaux d'ambassadeurs IA chez le client

  • Identifier les résistances et mettre en place les réponses adaptées

Impact & mesure

  • Définir et suivre les KPIs d'adoption et d'impact (taux d'usage, temps gagné, qualité, économies opérationnelles)

  • Mesurer les résultats et les présenter aux décideurs en comitologie

  • Mettre en place les dispositifs de retours utilisateurs et d'amélioration continue

  • Ajuster la trajectoire de déploiement selon les signaux terrain

Vie du cabinet

  • Encadrer et faire progresser des consultants juniors en mission

  • Contribuer à la prospection commerciale, aux propositions et aux soutenances

  • Capitaliser les retours d'expérience et enrichir les méthodologies et playbooks du cabinet

Profil recherché : avant tout, vous êtes passionné(e) par l’IA et souhaitez contribuer pour la rendre véritablement utile pour les entreprises

Formation

  • Bac+5 école d'ingénieur, école de commerce ou université

  • Spécialisation ou formation complémentaire en Data / IA et/ou en conduite du changement fortement appréciée

Expérience

  • 3 à 7 ans d'expérience, dont 2 ans au moins sur des projets IA, data ou transformation numérique

  • Vous avez accompagné au moins 2 projets de déploiement IA de bout en bout, du cadrage à l'adoption

  • Vous avez déjà préparé et animé des instances de Project Management et de pilotage face à des décideurs

  • Expérience en contexte grands comptes ou cabinet de conseil est fortement appréciable

  • Anglais courant est un plus

Outils & compétences techniques

  • Fondamentaux IA (LLM, RAG, agents) suffisants pour évaluer une faisabilité et dialoguer avec les Data Scientists

  • Construction de business cases chiffrés et de grilles de priorisation

  • Construction et présentation de dashboards (Tableau, PowerBI, Looker)

  • Bonne compréhension des enjeux data, gouvernance, sécurité et éthique IA

  • Compréhension générale des architectures cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure)

  • Notions de gestion de projet (planning, jalons, gestion des risques, méthodes Agile) suffisantes pour dialoguer avec un Delivery Manager et, si besoin, piloter seul un projet de moindre envergure

Compétences clés

  • Capacité à embarquer des acteurs aux intérêts parfois divergents

  • Data storytelling, vous présentez des résultats chiffrés de façon convaincante aux décideurs

  • Capacité à naviguer l'ambiguïté des grandes organisations

  • Veille IA active, vous intégrez les évolutions du marché dans vos recommandations

  • Orientation résultats, vous cherchez l'impact avant la production de livrables

raw.description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Are our Engineering principles aligned with your vision?

Then, Pennylane is the right place for you !

 

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

Simultaneously, we support accounting firms by enabling them to spend less time on redundant and repetitive tasks and more time on advising and supporting their clients. Already, over 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and more than 6,500 accounting firms use Pennylane in France! 🚀

 

About us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

 

In 6 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1100+ happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6,500 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

HOW you will contribute to the company as a Senior Software Engineer?

As a Senior Software Engineer at Pennylane, your squad is your primary focus. You will contribute to building reliable, scalable and user-focused products, while helping the engineers around you grow and raising the quality of our technical execution. You will:

  • Understand and frame user and product problems, using your product knowledge to help your squad deliver simple, pragmatic and valuable solutions.

  • Lead significant technical deliveries within your squad, from understanding the problem to designing, implementing, testing and operating the solution in production.

  • Investigate and resolve complex production issues, using monitoring, observability and data analysis tools to identify root causes and prevent recurrence.

  • Design and evolve robust solutions, identifying performance, scalability and reliability opportunities and turning them into pragmatic technical improvements.

  • Bring strong expertise in at least one major part of our stack, while being able to join a new team and become autonomous on a high-impact initiative within a few weeks.

  • Improve engineering practices across the organization, through high-quality code reviews, pair programming, documentation, RFCs and the adoption of AI-assisted development without compromising software quality.

  • Act as a role model and a driver for other engineers, sharing knowledge, providing actionable feedback and helping the team continuously improve its technical skills and ways of working.

  • Collaborate effectively with other teams when needed, proactively unblocking technical topics and clearly communicating progress, risks, decisions and results to the relevant stakeholders.

  • Contribute to the Pennylane tech community, through technical content, onboarding, interviews, incident resolution, tech initiatives, meetups or other community-building activities.

 

🥇 You’re the right candidate if you…

  • Have strong hands-on experience with Ruby on Rails and React (at least 7-8 years)

  • Combine technical expertise with strong product and business understanding, enjoy solving complex problems and care deeply about your users.

  • Are a collaborative team player, communicate clearly and take ownership of delivering reliable, pragmatic solutions.

  • Like being challenged and solving complex problems (accounting is complex in Europe)

  • Have strong communication skills and are capable of articulating your ideas clearly

 
 

🎁 What we offer

  • 🏢 You'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

  • 🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 30 vacations days paid by Pennylane

  • 💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

  • 📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

  • 🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

  • ⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

  • 🇬🇧 You’ll have access to Busuu to perfect your English or your French

  • 💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

  • 🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

 

  1. If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 13 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

  2. We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

 
 

🤝Hiring process

  • You will first have a general chat with a Talent Acquisition Manager (30 min)

  • You’ll then have a test-home assignment + a debriefing session with two of our software engineers (1 hour)

  • You’ll have a last culture-fit discussion with two people from our tech leadership (1 h)

 

We make sure we move fast ; you can expect the recruitment process with us to last between 15 and 25 days in total.

 

We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

 

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment. We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

 

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a Más información

Why this role exists

At Pennylane, SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) are central to making our product easier to discover and understand, while helping us reach new customers.

We are looking for an SEO & AI Content Specialist to work closely with our SEO Manager and the wider Growth team. Your mission will be to produce, improve and scale high-quality content that drives non-branded organic traffic and conversions, while embedding AI thoughtfully into the way we work.

This role is for someone who enjoys writing, structuring, optimising, measuring and iterating. You are curious about the evolution of search and eager to explore how people discover products through search engines and AI assistants such as ChatGPT and Perplexity.

🌍 What is Pennylane?

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and enable accountants to focus on advising their clients.

A few figures that illustrate our scale and ambition:

💻 More than 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane.

🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 More than 1,100 Pennylaners work across the company, representing more than 25 nationalities.

💰 More than €400 million raised since launch.

🌍 A remote-friendly, international culture as we continue to grow across Europe.

What you’ll do

You will work closely with our SEO Manager and the wider Growth team and :

Build AI-powered content workflows

  • Use AI to accelerate research, outlining, first drafts and content optimisation, while maintaining a high editorial standard.

  • Design repeatable workflows, including briefs, quality checklists, templates and editorial guidelines.

  • Help scale content production efficiently without compromising relevance, accuracy or clarity.

Produce and optimise high-value SEO content

  • Write, update and improve SEO content, including articles, pillar pages and landing pages, to generate non-branded organic traffic and conversions.

  • Turn search intent into clear, useful and well-structured content for Pennylane’s audiences.

  • Run continuous optimisation initiatives, including content refreshes, consolidation, internal linking and on-page improvements.

  • Work with stakeholders across Growth to ensure content supports broader acquisition priorities.

Help develop our GEO approach

  • Build an understanding of the questions and prompts prospects use in AI-powered discovery tools.

  • Adapt content to help ensure Pennylane is accurately understood and discoverable across emerging AI search journeys.

  • Test content formats, structures and optimisation approaches that improve visibility in AI-generated answers — without compromising the experience for human readers.

  • Share learnings and contribute to shaping Pennylane’s evolving SEO and GEO playbook.

Make decisions with data

  • Monitor and prioritise work based on SEO performance signals, including visibility, rankings, impressions, clicks, CTR, organic traffic and conversions.

  • Translate data into concrete, actionable recommendations.

  • Run experiments, measure their impact and iterate quickly and rigorously.

What you bring

  • You have initial, meaningful hands-on experience in SEO, ideally with published content you can share.

  • You are fluent in French, with strong writing and editing skills. You also have professional working proficiency in English.

  • You enjoy improving content and are motivated by the challenge of turning a good page into a high-performing one.

  • You take a pragmatic, data-informed approach: you form hypotheses, test them, measure outcomes and improve.

  • You already use AI tools in your day-to-day workflow and are excited to deepen your practice.

  • You have a sharp eye for structure, clarity, accuracy and editorial quality.

  • You are comfortable working in a fast-moving, collaborative environment and know how to focus on the initiatives with the greatest business impact.

🛠️ Tools and environment

You will work with tools such as Meteoria, Profound, Google Search Console, GA4, Semrush, Contentful and Notion.

What you can expect

  • A role with real room to propose, structure and improve how SEO works at Pennylane.

  • The opportunity to develop expertise at the intersection of SEO, content, GEO and AI.

  • A demanding and supportive team that values execution, learning and sound judgement.

  • A direct and visible impact on organic acquisition and conversion.

  • A remote-friendly working environment, with access to home-office equipment, coworking options where relevant and regular opportunities to meet teammates in person.

  • Benefits that support flexibility, wellbeing, connection and growth. These may vary depending on your country, contract type and role.

📍 Location and working model

This role can be based in Paris on a hybrid basis, or remotely from anywhere in France.

All interviews are held remotely:

  1. An initial conversation with Talent Acquisition (30 min).

  2. A conversation with the Hiring Manager (30 min).

  3. A case study and debrief with the Hiring Manager and a team member (1 hour).

  4. A final team-fit conversation with a Marketing Team Lead (30 min).

Pennylane is committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment, with equal opportunities for all candidates regardless of social or ethnic background, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability or any other personal characteristic.
